Quiz. Code. Conquer.

Most people prepare for DSA alone, stuck on the same problems and not sure where they stand. DSA WAR is a different kind of contest. It isn't about beating everyone else. It's about beating yesterday's version of yourself.

Over 3 rounds, you'll test what you know, find what you don't, and leave with sharper problem-solving than you came in with.

What's the battle?

Round 1:

  • The Quiz RoundA timed quiz on core DSA concepts: arrays, strings, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs, recursion, sorting, searching and complexity analysis. This round shows you where your fundamentals are strong and where they have cracks.

Round 2

  • Onwards: The Coding Rounds
    Real problems that make you think, plan and write clean code under time pressure. The difficulty rises with each round, so you'll feel yourself growing as you go.

Why you should be here

  • You'll learn faster than you do alone. Every problem teaches a pattern you can reuse in interviews, placements and real projects.
  • You'll get an honest picture of your level, without the pressure of a high-stakes exam.
  • You'll practice the way placements actually work: concepts first, then code, under a clock.
  • You'll build the habit. Showing up, struggling with a problem and finally cracking it is how good programmers are made.

Don't think of a wrong answer as a loss. Every one is a gap you now know about and can fix. Come to learn, and the results will follow.

Who can participate?

Open to all college students across India . Whether you're a first-year who just learned arrays or a final-year student polishing for placements, there's something here for you. You can participate individually.

Rules:

  • Registration is only through Unstop. Please register once with your own account. Duplicate or fake registrations will be disqualified.
  • Attempt every round honestly. Plagiarism, code sharing or any unfair means will lead to disqualification.
  • The quiz round will run in full-screen mode, so please use a stable connection and a laptop or desktop.
  • The organizers' decision is final.

Recognition:

Every participant who takes part will receive an e-certificate of participation. The top performers will earn Certificates of Merit for their performance.

Powered by Unstop.
